title: Review contact reasons and response times each week

steps.do: Close cases resolved more than seven days ago with no reply from the customer, and reopen any the customer wrote about again.
Count this week's cases per active customer by reason, the share answered within target, and repeat contacts within seven days.
Send products the top contact reasons with counts and the cases behind them, as a handoff.
For the top contact reason by volume, propose to the growth lead whether to remove it with a product or policy fix, answer it with published help, or keep handling it.

done_criteria.check: Does the top contact reason this week have a proposal open or decided, and does every count cite the cases it came from?
